author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Director James Cameron has signaled he's ready to move on from the Avatar franchise, even though Disney has reserved release dates for a potential Avatar 4 and 5. Outside of some documentaries and producing a few other projects for other filmmakers, Cameron has only made Avatar films for the past 20 years. The last one, Avatar: Fire and Ash, made around $1.4 billion at the global box office, but carried a hefty $300-400 million price tag, and made significantly less than the first two Avatars. 

#IGN #Gaming
title: James Cameron Wants to Prioritize "Other Stories" Over Avatar 4 and 5 - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Quarantine Zombies: Contamination trailer for this upcoming expansion to the zombie checkpoint simulation game. Quarantine Zombies has a heavy focus on narrative elements, exploration and survival in a zombie-infested Chicago. The new trailer showcases what you can expect with the Contamination expansion, which brings a new melee combat system, five new infection symptoms with three new tools for inspection, new and improved infected and refugees with more variation to clothes and faces, game mechanic balances, rebalanced character movement, and gamepad support. Quarantine Zombies: Contamination is available on PC today, August 5, 2026.

Quarantine Zombies is a first-person shooter meets quarantine inspection in post-apocalyptic Chicago. You’ve got 30 days until the army arrives. Hold out, fix your car, and fight your way through Chicago to the main checkpoint to save your little brother.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Quarantine Zombies: Contamination - Official Update 2.0 Launch Trailer

title: Angelic: Dark Symphony - Official Cinematic Teaser Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the final trailer for Insidious: Out of the Further, an upcoming horror movie starring Amelia Eve, Brandon Perea, and Lin Shaye (reprising her iconic role as Elise Rainier). In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

The screenplay for Insidious: Out of the Further is by Jacob Chase. Story by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Jacob Chase. Based on characters created by Leigh Whannell. It is produced by Jason Blum, Oren Peli, James Wan, and Leigh Whannell, p.g.a. Executive producers are Steven Schneider, Ryan Turek, and Bria
title: Insidious: Out of the Further - Official Final Trailer (2026) Amelia Eve, Lin Shaye, Brandon Perea
